```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
```


```{r}
# So for a case-wise CNV heatmap, the most sensible choice is to use 267 altered cases
# exclude AO92, APID, AQ3V
# if all samples are NEUT → NEUT
# if some samples show gain-side calls and some show loss-side calls for the same gene → MIXED
# otherwise collapse to the strongest state:
# HLAMP > AMP > GAIN
# HOMD > HETD
```


```{r}
#
# ===============================
# Paths
# ===============================
cnr_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/AURORA/CNVKit/Annotated_cnr_file"

tcga_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Reference/TCGA.BRCA.onco.genes.OncoVar.tsv"
icgc_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Reference/ICGC.BRCA.onco.genes.OncoVar.tsv"

# ===============================
# Load OncoVar genes
# ===============================
tcga_df <- fread(tcga_file) %>% mutate(Source = "TCGA")
icgc_df <- fread(icgc_file) %>% mutate(Source = "ICGC")
combined_df <- bind_rows(tcga_df, icgc_df)

# update this line if your gene column has a different name
gene_col_oncovar <- "Gene_symbol"

onco_genes <- combined_df %>%
  pull(all_of(gene_col_oncovar)) %>%
  unique() %>%
  na.omit()

cat("Number of OncoVar genes:", length(onco_genes), "\n")
```


```{r}
# ===============================
# List files
# ===============================
cnr_files <- list.files(
  path = cnr_dir,
  pattern = "\\.annotated\\.cnr$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Total files:", length(cnr_files), "\n")

# ===============================
# Read one CNR file
# ===============================
read_one_cnr <- function(f) {
  dt <- fread(f)

  sample_name <- basename(f) %>%
    str_remove("\\.annotated\\.cnr$")

  case_id <- sub("-.*", "", sample_name)

  corrected_call_col <- grep("\\.Corrected_Call$", names(dt), value = TRUE)

  if (length(corrected_call_col) == 0) return(NULL)

  dt %>%
    transmute(
      chromosome = chromosome,
      start = start,
      end = end,
      gene = gene,
      Sample = sample_name,
      Case = case_id,
      Corrected_Call = as.character(.data[[corrected_call_col[1]]])
    )
}

all_cnr <- map_dfr(cnr_files, read_one_cnr)

# ===============================
# Remove cases with no CNV at all
# ===============================
case_status <- all_cnr %>%
  group_by(Sample, Case) %>%
  summarise(
    has_CNV = any(!is.na(Corrected_Call) & Corrected_Call != "NEUT"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Case) %>%
  summarise(
    has_CNV = any(has_CNV),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

altered_cases <- case_status %>%
  filter(has_CNV) %>%
  pull(Case)

cat("Cases with CNV alteration:", length(altered_cases), "\n")

all_cnr <- all_cnr %>%
  filter(Case %in% altered_cases)
```


```{r}
# ===============================
# Split multi-gene rows
# ===============================
cnr_long <- all_cnr %>%
  separate_rows(gene, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(
    gene = str_trim(gene),
    Corrected_Call = str_trim(Corrected_Call)
  ) %>%
  filter(gene %in% onco_genes)

cat("Rows after filtering to OncoVar genes:", nrow(cnr_long), "\n")
cat("Genes present in CNR among OncoVar set:", length(unique(cnr_long$gene)), "\n")
```


```{r}
# ===============================
# Helper functions
# ===============================
gain_states <- c("GAIN", "AMP", "HLAMP")
loss_states <- c("HETD", "HOMD")

sample_call_rank <- c(
  "NEUT"  = 0,
  "HETD"  = 1,
  "HOMD"  = 2,
  "GAIN"  = 1,
  "AMP"   = 2,
  "HLAMP" = 3
)

collapse_sample_gene <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(na.omit(x))
  if (length(x) == 0) return("NEUT")
  if (all(x == "NEUT")) return("NEUT")

  # if both gain and loss present within same sample/gene across segments
  if (any(x %in% gain_states) & any(x %in% loss_states)) return("MIXED")

  if (any(x == "HLAMP")) return("HLAMP")
  if (any(x == "AMP"))   return("AMP")
  if (any(x == "GAIN"))  return("GAIN")
  if (any(x == "HOMD"))  return("HOMD")
  if (any(x == "HETD"))  return("HETD")
  return("NEUT")
}

collapse_case_gene <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(na.omit(x))
  if (length(x) == 0) return("NEUT")
  if (all(x == "NEUT")) return("NEUT")

  # if different samples from same case show gain and loss
  if (any(x %in% c("GAIN","AMP","HLAMP")) & any(x %in% c("HETD","HOMD"))) return("MIXED")
  if ("MIXED" %in% x) return("MIXED")

  if (any(x == "HLAMP")) return("HLAMP")
  if (any(x == "AMP"))   return("AMP")
  if (any(x == "GAIN"))  return("GAIN")
  if (any(x == "HOMD"))  return("HOMD")
  if (any(x == "HETD"))  return("HETD")
  return("NEUT")
}

# ===============================
# Collapse to Sample-Gene first
# ===============================
sample_gene_calls <- cnr_long %>%
  group_by(Sample, Case, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    Call = collapse_sample_gene(Corrected_Call),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ===============================
# Collapse Sample-Gene to Case-Gene
# ===============================
case_gene_calls <- sample_gene_calls %>%
  group_by(Case, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    Call = collapse_case_gene(Call),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ===============================
# Make heatmap matrix
# ===============================
heatmap_df <- case_gene_calls %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Case,
    values_from = Call,
    values_fill = "NEUT"
  )

heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_df[, -1])
rownames(heatmap_mat) <- heatmap_df$gene

# keep genes altered in at least one case
heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[
  apply(heatmap_mat, 1, function(x) any(x != "NEUT")),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# order genes and cases by alteration burden
gene_order <- order(apply(heatmap_mat, 1, function(x) sum(x != "NEUT")), decreasing = TRUE)
case_order <- order(apply(heatmap_mat, 2, function(x) sum(x != "NEUT")), decreasing = TRUE)

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[gene_order, case_order, drop = FALSE]

cat("Final heatmap dimensions:", nrow(heatmap_mat), "genes x", ncol(heatmap_mat), "cases\n")
```


```{r}
# ===============================
# Colors
# ===============================
cnv_colors <- c(
  "HLAMP" = "#B2182B",
  "AMP"   = "#EF8A62",
  "GAIN"  = "#FDCC8A",
  "NEUT"  = "white",
  "HETD"  = "#A6BDDB",
  "HOMD"  = "#2166AC",
  "MIXED" = "#6A3D9A"
)

# ===============================
# Plot
# ===============================
ht <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  name = "CNV",
  col = cnv_colors,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey90"),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_title = "Case-wise CNV heatmap of OncoVar breast cancer genes",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c("HLAMP", "AMP", "GAIN", "NEUT", "HETD", "HOMD", "MIXED"),
    labels = c("HLAMP", "AMP", "GAIN", "NEUT", "HETD", "HOMD", "MIXED")
  )
)

draw(ht)
```
```{r}
# ===============================
# Save as PDF
# ===============================
pdf("Casewise_OncoVar_CNV_heatmap.pdf", width = 16, height = 10)
draw(ht)
dev.off()

# ===============================
# Save as PNG
# ===============================
png("Casewise_OncoVar_CNV_heatmap.png", width = 16, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
draw(ht)
dev.off()

```
